caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure enclosed within an oval, irregularly shaped frame. The figure is shown frontally, with a round face, closed eyes, and a serene expression. A halo composed of simple, straight golden lines encircles the head. The person has a robe that is predominantly red, with lighter and darker patches, and a green, hooded mantle or cloak draped over the head and body. The hands of the figure are positioned together at mid-torso, holding a small book with noticeable golden pages. The background inside the oval is brown with texture resembling wood and contains two symmetrical, stylized plant or flower motifs on either side of the figure, in faded red and green. The surrounding oval has a dark border and is uneven, showing areas where the color is chipped or worn off. The image is set on an off-white sheet with two large, rectangular, yellowish shapes to the left and right. In the bottom right, text reads, “Hazel G. Claflin - Taos, N.M.”
title: Retablo - Santa Maria
